notes: FY2025 (year ended December 31, 2025), IFRS, from the 2025 Universal Registration Document. Interest paid on debt and on leases (290 + 545) and operating tax paid (4,656) sit inside operating activities; only the 244 of dividend-related tax in financing is added. The statement's 'TOTAL TAX PAID' is 4,901; the two printed parts sum to 4,900 (rounding, and nil tax on investment disposals). Capex uses gross PP&E and intangible purchases from note 15.3 rather than the net 'Operating investments' line. revenueIncludesExcise is null: the revenue policy says revenue is net of all forms of discount but does not say whether excise duties on Wines and Spirits are included or deducted. Lease principal (2,974) noted, not added. FX: calendar-2025 average.
